claims.quote: This nano fish comes from southern India (Kerala) and grows to a maximum length of 3 cm.
The dadio, Laubuka dadiburjori, is a small cyprinid endemic to southern India, recorded from Goa, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

regions.name: Meenachil
regions.quote: Endemic to southern India with records from the states of Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu, including the rivers Meenachil, Bharatapuzha, Chalakkudy, and Sita.
